{{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW An Ice Guy.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Guy]] |location= Kara Kara Bazaar |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Purple Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} {{Term/Store|An Ice Guy||Series, BotW}} is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|An Ice Guy}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Kara Kara Bazaar}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== At the [[Kara Kara Bazaar]], [[Link]] will encounter a [[Rito]] named [[Guy]] sitting at the edge of the water. He left [[Rito Village]] to earn money out in the world,{{Cite|I had a great plan, you know. I left Rito Village to try to earn some money out in the world.|Guy|BotW}} but the [[Heat]] of the [[Gerudo Desert]] has stalled his progress.{{Cite|But it's so incredibly hot here during the day. It's been tough to work up the will to go any farther.|Guy|BotW}} Despite not being able to enter, he would like to see [[Gerudo Town]].{{Cite|I would like to see what Gerudo Town looks like, even if I can't go inside... It's just so hot...|Guy|BotW}} Guy mentions to Link that he has heard of an [[Elixir]] that could help him made from [[Insect]]s with cooling effects and [[Monster Part]]s.{{Cite|I heard there's an {{Color BotW|Red|elixir that can help beat the heat}}. It's made from {{Color BotW|Blue|insects with cooling effects}} and {{Color BotW|Blue|monster parts}}.|Guy|BotW}} However, he is unable to find this Elixir being sold anywhere.{{Cite|But they don't seem to be selling the elixir anywhere...|Guy|BotW}} He has heard that these Insects can be found in the [[Gerudo Highlands]],{{Cite|I've heard {{Color BotW|Blue|insects with these cooling effects}} live in {{Color BotW|Red|the cold parts of the Gerudo Highlands}}, but...|Guy|BotW}} but he does not want to venture there himself due to the dangerous [[Enemies in Breath of the Wild|monsters]] that inhabit the area.{{Cite|Well, the monsters there are rough, to say the least, so I'm not having a lot of success getting myself motivated.|Guy|BotW}} After Link is done talking to him, he will receive the [[Side Quest]]. In order to complete the Side Quest, Link must [[Cooking|Cook]] either a [[Cold Darner]] or a [[Winterwing Butterfly]] with Monster Parts to make a [[Chilly Elixir]]. [[Beedle]], who can be found nearby, sells Cold Darners for 10 [[Rupee]]s. Once he is in possession of a Chilly Elixir, Link can return to Guy.{{Cite|Oh? Could it be?|Guy|BotW}} He will thank Link, as he can now traverse the Gerudo Desert during the day.{{Cite|Thank you! Now I can get across the desert while it's still light out!|Guy|BotW}} As a reward, he gives Link a [[Purple Rupee]].{{Cite|Here, let me give you something in return.|Guy|BotW}} This completes the Side Quest. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Guy of the Kara Kara Bazaar needs a {{Color BotW|Red|cooling elixir}} to beat the heat. The medicine is made by combining a {{Color BotW|Red|bug with chilling effects}} with {{Color BotW|Red|monster parts}}. You'll find the bug in question in the {{Color BotW|Red|cooler parts of the Gerudo Highlands}}. |- | Complete | You made a cooling elixir by combining a chilling insect with monster parts. Guy appreciated what you did for him. Your knowledge of the ingredients for a cooling elixir could come in handy later. }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Chilly Elixir * Guy * Kara Kara Bazaar }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
